capabilities: Render a parent/siblings/children header block in Reading view and Live Preview
Show a children index in the note body
Create notes, folder notes and folders from the index
Sort and tint navigation pills by file type
Fold the block away and hide it per note via frontmatter
disambiguation: Not a graph or outline navigator; it only shows a note's position in the folder tree.
extras: Ships English and Simplified Chinese, offers a BRAT preview install, and becomes strictly read-only when the create button is turned off. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later.
problem: To see where a note sits in the folder tree, or what else is in its folder, you have to leave the note and use the file explorer.

relations.evidence: Inspired by SiYuan's hierarchyNavigate and built on AidenLx's Folder Note semantics.
Works with Folder Note, so a Folder Note navigates as the folder it represents

summary: Renders a parent, siblings and children navigation block at the top of each note, based on the folder tree.
